Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a flawed heuristic that equated “tabloid-style” with either tabloid print format or merely covering sensational topics, weighting them equally and using a low threshold. This conflates physical format with editorial tone and would misclassify Skeptical Inquirer (which critically examines sensational claims, not tabloid-style journalism). This conceptual error would yield the wrong answer even if later web searches were executed perfectly.
